back: The model is a small part; the gap is gateway, guardrails, caching, retries, fallbacks, streaming, observability and budgets.
Gateway, input guardrails, prompt router, cache, retrieval/tools and model call, output guardrails, logging and cost tracking, streamed response.
Cost adds; latency is the max of the group. Sequential steps add latency.
Latency is linear in generated tokens and output tokens cost more than input tokens.
$\text{cost}\,(1-p^k)/(1-p)$ for failure probability p and k attempts (failed attempts billed).
Timeouts, capped retries with backoff and jitter on idempotent calls, fallbacks, streaming, budgets, request ids.
Per-stage spans with prompt version, model, tokens, cache hit, retrieval ids, tool calls, guardrail verdicts, latency, cost.
State, nodes (state to partial update), edges (static or conditional), reducers (how updates merge).
Nodes agent and tools; conditional edge agent -> tools if a tool call is pending else end; edge tools -> agent.
Without an append reducer on messages, the next update overwrites the history silently.
Checkpointing, interrupts (human in the loop), streaming of events, time-travel from past checkpoints.
A runaway loop would otherwise be unbounded in cost and time; return status max_steps.
Tools (actions), resources (URI-addressed content), prompts (templates), exposed by servers to a host's clients over JSON-RPC.
Choose tools, make untrusted content safe, or replace approvals and least privilege.
